_comment: Tags the scheduled poll keeps in sync. Every 30 minutes the plan job runs
scripts/check-current.sh over this list and syncs only the entries whose
upstream digest differs from prod -- so adding a tag here is a one-line,
reviewable change, and a quiet poll tick costs seconds.
Tag choice is not cosmetic. Observed on nicksdemoorg/dhi-node:
- debian-based tags ship OpenVEX; alpine-based ones do not. Without VEX the
scan gate runs unsuppressed, so a hardened image can report CVEs its vendor
has already assessed as not affecting it.
- -dev tags include a shell and package manager. They exist for build stages
and are deliberately NOT synced to a registry that feeds production.
requireVex fails the verify gate when OpenVEX is absent. Set it on tags where
policy demands VEX and the base image provides it.
24-alpine is deliberately NOT listed. It is the manual negative-test tag
(REQUIRE_VEX=1 make verify REPO=dhi-node TAG=24-alpine): with requireVex false
the poll would quietly promote it out of quarantine and flatten the demo's
gate-blocked example; with true it would fail every 30 minutes. Auto-syncing
a tag that exists to demonstrate failure is a category error.
